methods.name: local_existing_tools
methods.instructions: Inspect the supplied existing declarations and the current checked proof for local shortening through existing lemmas, definitional simplification or rewriting. Keep imports, definitions and the original goal fixed. Return a candidate only as a full proof term with all helper source charged; otherwise retain the checked incumbent with an honest account of this bounded attempt. No new theory package is available, and a retain response does not certify tool exhaustion.
